responsibility: This file implements C/C++ name-conflict avoidance and required-definition tracking for the mc translator's code generator. It maintains per-declaration scopes as symbol trees, global keyword and macro sets, and many feature flags recording whether converted code used items like NULL, bool helpers, limits macros, malloc/free, unistd, exception support, complex types, or M2RTS; it can then mangle conflicting identifiers via keyc_cname/keyc_cnamen and emit the necessary include directives, macro definitions, and compatibility declarations through mcPretty, making it the target-language naming and prologue-generation subsystem for C and C++ output.
same_name_distinction: Implements the keyc services declared in Gkeyc.h by maintaining keyword/macro symbol trees, per-scope name state, feature-use flags, identifier mangling logic, and emitted support definitions/includes. Unlike the header, it contains the actual conflict-detection state and prologue-generation code for C/C++ output.
